request: if you mix 2 litres of 10% juice with 3 litres of 20% juice, how strong is the mix?

beats.intent: Two jugs: 2 litres at 10% juice and 3 litres at 20% juice, the juice part shaded at the bottom
beats.narration: One jug holds two litres of drink that is ten percent juice. Another holds three litres at twenty percent.
beats.code:
stage.title("Mixing two drinks")
L = 0.6
base = -2.0
jug = lambda x, litres, frac, col: VGroup(Rectangle(width=1.3, height=litres * L, color=WHITE).move_to([x, base + litres * L / 2, 0]), Rectangle(width=1.3, height=litres * L * frac, color=col, fill_opacity=0.8, stroke_width=0).move_to([x, base + litres * L * frac / 2, 0]))
a = jug(-5.2, 2, 0.10, ORANGE)
b = jug(-3.2, 3, 0.20, ORANGE)
stage.play(FadeIn(a), FadeIn(b))
stage.add(a, b)
stage.label(a, "2 L at 10%", direction=UP)
stage.label(b, "3 L at 20%", direction=UP)

beats.intent: The juice in each jug labelled: 0.2 L and 0.6 L
beats.narration: The first jug has a tenth of two litres of juice, nought point two. The second has a fifth of three, nought point six.
beats.code: stage.play(FadeIn(Text("0.2 L", font_size=24, color=ORANGE).next_to(a[1], DOWN, buff=0.15)), FadeIn(Text("0.6 L", font_size=24, color=ORANGE).next_to(b[1], DOWN, buff=0.15)))

beats.intent: Both poured into one 5 litre jug holding 0.8 litres of juice
beats.narration: Pour both into one jug: five litres of drink holding nought point eight litres of juice.
beats.code:
mix = jug(-0.8, 5, 0.16, ORANGE)
stage.play(TransformFromCopy(VGroup(a, b), mix), run_time=1.5)
stage.add(mix)
stage.label(mix, "5 L with 0.8 L juice", direction=RIGHT, color=ORANGE)

beats.intent: The jugs beside (0.2 + 0.6) ÷ 5 = 0.16 = 16%, not the 15% midpoint
beats.narration: Nought point eight out of five is sixteen percent, not fifteen: there's more of the stronger drink, so it counts for more.

request: how do you read a stem-and-leaf diagram?

beats.narration: Ten students' scores out of fifty, in order.
beats.code:
stage.title("Stem and leaf")
data = [12, 15, 17, 21, 23, 23, 28, 31, 34, 40]
raw = VGroup(*[Text(str(v), font_size=28) for v in data]).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.35).move_to([-1.8, 2.2, 0])
stage.play(FadeIn(raw))
stage.add(raw)

beats.intent: The diagram: stems 1 to 4 down the left, units as leaves along each row
beats.narration: Split each score into its tens, the stem, and its units, the leaf. Each stem gets one row.
beats.code:
stems = VGroup(*[Text(str(s), font_size=32, color=BLUE).move_to([-5.2, 1.0 - 0.65 * i, 0]) for i, s in enumerate((1, 2, 3, 4))])
bar = Line([-4.85, 1.35, 0], [-4.85, -1.3, 0], color=WHITE)
rows = {1: [2, 5, 7], 2: [1, 3, 3, 8], 3: [1, 4], 4: [0]}
leaves = VGroup()
for i, s in enumerate((1, 2, 3, 4)):
    for j, l in enumerate(rows[s]):
        leaves.add(Text(str(l), font_size=32).move_to([-4.4 + 0.5 * j, 1.0 - 0.65 * i, 0]))
stage.play(FadeIn(stems), Create(bar))
stage.play(LaggedStart(*[FadeIn(l) for l in leaves], lag_ratio=0.08))
stage.add(stems, bar, leaves)
stage.play(FadeIn(Text("key: 2 | 3 = 23", font_size=24, color=GREY_B).move_to([-4.2, -1.9, 0])))

beats.intent: The 5th and 6th leaves, 3 and 3 in the 20s row, highlighted as the middle
beats.narration: With ten scores the middle sits between the fifth and sixth. Counting leaves: the fifth and sixth are both twenty three.
beats.code:
mid = SurroundingRectangle(VGroup(leaves[4], leaves[5]), color=YELLOW, buff=0.1)
stage.play(Create(mid))
stage.add(mid)
stage.play(FadeIn(Text("← 5th and 6th", font_size=26, color=YELLOW).move_to([-1.6, 1.0 - 0.65, 0])))

beats.intent: The diagram beside median = 23 and range = 40 − 12 = 28
beats.narration: So the median is twenty three. The first leaf and the last give the range: forty minus twelve, twenty eight.

request: why is a sphere two thirds of the cylinder around it?

beats.intent: A ball of radius r fitting exactly inside a cylinder of radius r and height 2r
beats.narration: A ball sits exactly inside a can: the can's radius is the ball's radius r, and its height is two r.
beats.code:
stage.title("Sphere in a cylinder")
r = 1.3
c = np.array([-4.2, -0.4, 0])
can = VGroup(Line(c + np.array([-r, -r, 0]), c + np.array([-r, r, 0])), Line(c + np.array([r, -r, 0]), c + np.array([r, r, 0])), Ellipse(width=2 * r, height=0.45).move_to(c + r * UP), Ellipse(width=2 * r, height=0.45).move_to(c + r * DOWN)).set_color(WHITE)
ball = Circle(radius=r, color=BLUE, fill_opacity=0.35).move_to(c)
stage.play(Create(can), FadeIn(ball))
stage.add(can, ball)
stage.label(Line(c, c + r * RIGHT), "r", direction=UP, color=YELLOW)
stage.play(Create(Line(c, c + r * RIGHT, color=YELLOW)))

beats.intent: A bar for the cylinder's volume 2πr³, split into three equal parts
beats.narration: The can holds pi r squared times two r: two pi r cubed. Split that into three equal parts.
beats.code:
cyl_bar = VGroup(*[Rectangle(width=1.0, height=0.7, color=WHITE, fill_opacity=0.1) for _ in range(3)]).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0).move_to([-0.6, 1.0, 0])
stage.play(FadeIn(cyl_bar))
stage.add(cyl_bar)
stage.label(cyl_bar, "can: 2πr³", direction=RIGHT)

beats.intent: A bar for the ball's volume 4/3 πr³, exactly two of the three parts
beats.narration: The ball holds four thirds pi r cubed: exactly two of those three parts. Archimedes was so proud of this he had it carved on his tomb.
beats.code:
sph_bar = VGroup(*[Rectangle(width=1.0, height=0.7, color=BLUE, fill_opacity=0.6) for _ in range(2)]).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0).next_to(cyl_bar, DOWN, buff=0.4, aligned_edge=LEFT)
stage.play(GrowFromEdge(sph_bar, LEFT))
stage.add(sph_bar)
stage.label(sph_bar, "ball: 4/3 πr³", direction=RIGHT, color=BLUE)

beats.narration: Divide one by the other and everything cancels except two thirds.
There are three hundred people at a fair.
beats.code:
stage.title("A percentage of a percentage")
w = 9
x0 = -6.2
whole = Rectangle(width=w, height=0.7, color=WHITE).move_to([x0 + w / 2, 1.2, 0])
stage.play(Create(whole))
stage.add(whole)
stage.label(whole, "300 people", direction=UP)

beats.intent: Half the bar shaded: 50% are adults, 150
beats.narration: Half of them are adults: a hundred and fifty.
beats.code:
adults = Rectangle(width=w / 2, height=0.7, color=BLUE, fill_opacity=0.4).move_to([x0 + w / 4, 1.2, 0])
stage.play(FadeIn(adults))
stage.add(adults)
stage.play(FadeIn(Text("adults: 150", font_size=26).move_to(adults)))

beats.intent: A fifth of the adult part shaded darker: 20% of 150 = 30 adults with a dog
beats.narration: Twenty percent of the adults brought a dog. A fifth of a hundred and fifty is thirty.
beats.code:
dogs = Rectangle(width=w / 10, height=0.7, color=ORANGE, fill_opacity=0.8).move_to([x0 + w / 20, 0.0, 0])
stage.play(TransformFromCopy(adults, dogs))
stage.add(dogs)
stage.label(dogs, "30 with a dog", direction=RIGHT, color=ORANGE)
ticks = VGroup(*[DashedLine([x0 + k * w / 10, 1.55, 0], [x0 + k * w / 10, -0.4, 0], color=GREY_B) for k in (1, 5)])
stage.play(Create(ticks))
stage.add(ticks)

beats.intent: The bars beside 0.2 × 0.5 × 300 = 30, which is 10% of everyone
beats.narration: Twenty percent of fifty percent is nought point two times nought point five: ten percent of the whole crowd.
